Context: 15. Miscellaneous

1. Additions / Alterations in Housing Upgradation Scheme, 2018 (HUS-2018) for General Pool Residential Accommodation (GPRA).It has been decided to provide the prescribed facilities i.e. Civil and Electrical works under Housing Upgradation Scheme, 2018 (HUS-2018) subject to availability of funds in all GPRA quarters as well as quarters in other pools which are being maintained by CPWD, whether occupied or vacant (except for Type I Quarters) in each colony with the consent of the concerned allottees. - GIO
